moral_story.title: Moral Story for Kids | The Kind Little Rabbit 🐰 | Fun Learning Kids
moral_story.voice_text: Ek jungle mein ek pyara khargosh rehta tha. Ek din usne ek nanhi chidiya ko ghonsle se gira dekha. Usne turant uski madad ki aur use ped par wapas rakha. Seekh: Dusron ki madad karna sabse achhi aadat hai.

Welcome to Fun Learning Kids! 🌟

Enjoy today's sweet Hindi moral story about a kind little rabbit helping a baby bird.

Subscribe for more educational kids stories!

#MoralStory #KidsLearning #HindiStory #FunLearningKids

subtitles_en: Number 1! Look up at the sky, there is one bright Sun.
We each have one happy heart inside.
Let's count: Number One!
numbers.description:
Counting is fun! Learn Number 1 with the bright sun in the sky. ☀️🔢

#Number1 #LearnCounting #PreschoolMath #FunLearningKids

numbers.title: Numbers Learning for Kids | Learn Number 2 (Two) 👀 | Fun Learning Kids
numbers.voice_text: Number do! Humari do aankhen hoti hain dekhne ke liye. Humare do kaan sunne ke liye. Ek aur do!
subtitles_en: Number 2! We have two eyes to see the world.
We have two ears to hear sweet music.
Count with me: One, Two!
numbers.description:
Learn Number 2 with two eyes, two ears, and two little hands! 👀✌️

#Number2 #CountingForKids #ToddlerMath #FunLearningKids

numbers.title: Numbers Learning for Kids | Learn Number 3 (Three) 🚦 | Fun Learning Kids
numbers.voice_text: Number teen! Traffic light mein teen rang hote hain: laal, peela aur hara. Triangle ke teen kone hote hain. Ek, do, teen!
subtitles_en: Number 3! A traffic light has three colors: Red, Yellow, Green.
A triangle has three points.
Count together: One, Two, Three!
numbers.description:
Learn Number 3 with traffic light colors and triangles! 🚦🔺

#Number3 #LearnToCount #KidsMath #FunLearningKids

numbers.title: Numbers Learning for Kids | Learn Number 4 (Four) 🚗 | Fun Learning Kids
numbers.voice_text: Number chaar! Ek car ke chaar pahiye hote hain. Ek table ke chaar paye hote hain. Ek, do, teen, chaar!
subtitles_en: Number 4! A car rolls smoothly on four wheels.
A table stands steady on four legs.
Let's count: One, Two, Three, Four!
numbers.description:
Number 4 with car wheels and chairs! Fun early math for young children. 🚗🔢

#Number4 #CountingKids #PreschoolLearning #FunLearningKids

numbers.title: Numbers Learning for Kids | Learn Number 5 (Five) 🖐️ | Fun Learning Kids
numbers.voice_text: Number paanch! Humare ek haath mein paanch ungliyan hoti hain. Chaliye unhe ginte hain: ek, do, teen, chaar, paanch!
subtitles_en: Number 5! High five! We have five fingers on our hand.
Count them: One, Two, Three, Four, Five!
Great job counting Number Five!
numbers.description:
High Five! Count all 5 fingers on your hand with Fun Learning Kids! 🖐️⭐

#Number5 #HighFive #KidsCounting #FunLearningKids

Let's count all together: Number Six!
Awesome counting skills!
numbers.description:
Learn to count Number 6 (Six)! Educational numbers learning for toddlers. 🖍️
